title: Revamp time-series chart layer for accessibility and performance
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: Our current time-series chart component is implemented with SVG primitives and a dense layering of interactive elements. This produces accessibility gaps (screen reader unreadable tooltips, lack of keyboard affordances) and performance issues on datasets >2k points (jank during scrubbing, slow initial render). Goal: deliver a reworked chart layer and component API that meets a11y standards, reduces median interaction latency by >=50% on large series, and provides clear design tokens for consistent theming across Console and customer-facing dashboards. Design scope covers legend behavior, tooltips, keyboard interactions, reduced-motion, and visual tokens (colors/line weights/point sizes) as well as documented fallbacks (canvas vs SVG).
acceptance_criteria: Screen-reader friendly tooltips: when a data point receives focus, an ARIA live region announces timestamp and value in natural language
Full keyboard navigation: chart elements reachable via Tab/Arrow keys, with clear focus ring that uses the design system focus token
Legend accessibility: legends can be toggled via keyboard and convey on/off state to assistive tech
Performance targets: cold render of a 50k-point series completes < 400ms on target machines (M1 equivalent) or gracefully falls back to aggregated rendering
Visual parity: line smoothing, color tokens, and point visibility match approved Figma frames for Desktop and Compact variants
Configurable rendering strategy: component exposes renderingMode: ["auto", "svg", "canvas", "hybrid"] documented with recommended thresholds
Tooltip behavior: supports both hover and focus, respects prefers-reduced-motion, and allows a stateless renderless API for custom tooltips
Unit and visual tests added: storybook stories for keyboard flow, high-density data, legend virtualization, and color token theming
comments: 2026-03-02 Maya Chen: Kickoff sync with Eng (Alexei, Priya). Agreed to prototype canvas fallback and an ARIA live region pattern. Action: design to provide keyboard flows and token mapping by 2026-03-09.

2026-03-05 Alexei Novak: Prototype shows ~3x faster scrubbing with canvas + off-main-thread downsampling. Edge cases: tooltip hover zones require hit-testing layer; will propose an overlay interaction layer.
2026-03-07 Maya Chen: Updated Figma with two variants: 'Focused Interaction' (large focus ring + compact points) and 'Dense Readout' (minimal points + aggregated area). See figma link.

2026-03-09 Accessibility review (Kendra Li): Requested explicit keyboard focus order, aria-label formats, and confirmation on live-region phrasing. Avoid numeric-only announcements; include units (e.g., '12.3 tokens per second at 14:12 UTC').

2026-03-10 Alexei Novak: Engineering note: will expose prop 'aggregationStrategy' with options ['"largestBucket"','"avgBucket"','"maxPerPixel"'] and default to 'largestBucket' for auto mode. Intend to use a web worker for downsampling for >5k points.

2026-03-11 Design review: Approve focus token usage (token: ds.focus.400) and color contrasts adjusted to WCAG AA for normal text. Plan to add a 'low-contrast' variant for dense visualizations used internally.
2026-03-12 Priya Shah (Engineering): Added smoke test harness in GH PR, rendering-mode flag wired into storybook. Next: polish tooltip wording and finalize keyboard microcopy.
